purpose: Close the missing RED/trace coverage for the gfx1151 rows=8 FP16 indexed shared-statecache24 GDN leaf and verify that its inherited FP32 dispatch choice remains locally optimal against the plain FP16 indexed sibling.

software.note: The audit hardening changes do not modify gdn.hip; the measured device body is exactly the committed b4f6e135c kernel source identified by SHA-256.

correctness.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_qwen35_gguf_gdn_fp16_state.py tests/test_qwen35_linear_attn_decode_batch_indexed.py tests/test_qwen35_gguf_gdn_prefill_routing.py tests/test_gguf_packed_ar_bench.py tests/test_gfx1151_backend.py
correctness.oracle: independent NumPy host replay with FP32 accumulation and FP16 state round-trip

event_ab.protocol: 20 counterbalanced pairs; 100 launches per timed HIP-event interval after 20 warmup pairs; median milliseconds per launch

decision: Keep the gfx1151 rows>=8 shared-statecache24 FP16 override. It is correct on the real Qwen3.8 GDN shape, appears under the expected _Float16/STATE_CACHE_ROWS=24 symbol, and is 1.094x faster than the plain FP16 indexed sibling in the counterbalanced leaf A/B. This validates only the leaf choice; it does not qualify the complete c>N production route.
